title: SubmitRequest
description: Request to the execution edge carrying a caller-minted intent identifier. The action selects one of four operations, each under the same at-most-once intent rules: deal (market order, optionally with protective levels), pending (buy or sell stop or limit order resting at the broker), sltp (new protective levels for an open position) and remove (cancel a working pending order). When action is omitted the request is a plain market order without protective levels, as in edge 1.1; sl and tp are then refused, so protective levels always name an explicit deal or pending action.

intent_id.description: Caller-minted UUID identifying this submission intent for at-most-once semantics.

action.description: Operation requested. deal and pending carry an order; sltp carries symbol, position, sl and tp; remove carries symbol and order_ticket.

order.description: Order parameters for deal and pending actions. For pending, type is one of 2 (buy limit), 3 (sell limit), 4 (buy stop) or 5 (sell stop) and price is required.

symbol.description: Financial instrument ticker symbol for sltp and remove.

position.description: Position ticket whose protective levels are replaced by sltp.

sl.description: Stop loss level for sltp. Zero removes the stop loss.

tp.description: Take profit level for sltp. Zero removes the take profit.

order_ticket.description: Ticket of the working pending order removed by the remove action.
